### [Custom thread subscriptions are being deprecated](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-08-10-custom-thread-subscriptions-are-being-deprecated)

GitHub - `deprecated` / `deprecated` - High impact

You’ll no longer be able to configure custom thread subscriptions for GitHub notifications. What’s changing As part of this rollout, GitHub will remove support for custom thread subscription settings.

**Why it matters:** This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.

**Next action:** Identify affected workloads, verify the effective date, and create a tested migration action.
